title: Worlds
needsRunning: – the server must be running for this.

switchConfirm.title: Switch world
switchConfirm.message: Switch to world "{{name}}"? The server will restart to do so.

create.title: Create new world
create.description: Sets the active world anew and restarts the server; the world is generated on startup.

upload.title: Upload world (.tar.gz)
upload.description: Import a world archive exported via "Download" under a new name (max. 50 MB).

pregen.title: Pregeneration (Chunky)
pregen.description: Generates chunks in advance for the active world. Chunky is installed automatically if needed (then a server restart). Progress appears in the console.
pregen.descriptionWithWorld: Generates chunks in advance for the active world ("{{world}}"). Chunky is installed automatically if needed (then a server restart). Progress appears in the console.
